summary: Ansible 9 is based on ansible-core 2.16, and the porting guide should be read together with the Ansible 9 changelog.

answer_card.title: Ansible 9 is based on ansible-core 2.16
answer_card.answer_md: **Ansible 9** bundles **ansible-core 2.16**. Read the Ansible 9 porting guide together with the Ansible 9 changelog to find changes you need to make.
